captured_by: EE Writer 1 (Claude Code), Economic Evidence v1 PR B
method: Official documentation pages read with a web-fetch tool that returns a processed text rendering (not raw bytes). No raw bytes or byte hashes were kept, so these are dated notes, not immutable documents. No venue endpoint (public or order) was called.

facts.finding: Contract counts are fixed point: minimum granularity 0.01 contracts; *_fp fields are strings with 0-2 decimals on input and 2 in responses; fractional values appear elsewhere in the API, for example in fills, even without fractional orders.
facts.conformance_rule: Never truncate a Kalshi quantity to an integer; preserve the native 0.01 step (opportunity.KALSHI_BINARY_UNITS.quantity_step). The fee model does not price fractional fills (opportunity.price_depth_fill refuses them).

facts.finding: A winning Novig contract pays 1 cent. Prices are decimal probabilities on a banded grid (0.001-0.050 step 0.001; 0.055-0.945 step 0.005; 0.950-0.999 step 0.001).
quotes: A winning contract pays full value, 1¢.
facts.conformance_rule: A Novig native count is never reused as a count of $1 contracts (opportunity.NOVIG_V3_UNITS.payout_per_unit = 0.01; UnitSemantics.incompatibility refuses mixing).

facts.finding: Order placement is documented as not idempotent. clientId is a label the exchange never checks for uniqueness, so a replay places a second order. HTTP 201 means queued, not resting; the private stream's open event confirms resting.
quotes: The exchange never checks it for uniqueness, so a replay places a second order.
facts.conformance_rule: An execution design must never retry a Novig placement blindly or treat clientId as an exactly-once key, and must never treat 201 as resting (docs/decisions/0035-execution-package-design.md).

facts.status: VERIFIED_FROM_DOCS for the documentation text; production availability UNVERIFIED
facts.finding: The order-book endpoint is documented as unauthenticated, with no signature, throttled per IP, with a seq field and ETag / If-None-Match (304) support. Prices are decimal probabilities and quantities are integer counts of 1-cent contracts. The examples use the QA host https://api.qa.novig.com.
quotes: Unauthenticated. No signature. Throttled per IP at the edge.
facts.conformance_rule: Do not claim production public access, and do not widen collection, from QA examples. The repository's older NEEDS_ACCESS assumption stays until production host access and terms are verified.

facts.status: VERIFIED_FROM_DOCS for the hostnames; public-book availability in production UNVERIFIED
facts.finding: QA https://api.qa.novig.com (wss://api.qa.novig.com); production https://api.novig.com. A key works only in the environment where it was created, and production rejects a QA key. The environments page does not say whether the unauthenticated public book is available in production.
quotes: A key works only in the environment where you created it.
facts.conformance_rule: Treat QA and production as separate evidence. Production public-book access stays UNVERIFIED until a separately authorized, bounded check.

fee_findings.raised_by: EE Writer 2 (PR C, #101): the public series record reports a standard fee type with multiplier 1 (not re-read here: no new network call)
fee_findings.repository_evidence: The owner-supplied Kalshi fee schedule PDF (effective 2026-07-07; experiments/EXP-001-kxhighny-nws-vs-market/fee_verification/pdf_nonstandard_series.json) lists KXNFLGAME ('Professional Football Game') on the Non-Standard Fees list with maker_multiplier 1 and taker_multiplier 1.
fee_findings.reading: The two sources agree on a taker multiplier of 1. They differ on whether the series is 'non-standard': the PDF lists it, apparently for its maker fees. Whether the general quadratic taker formula (coefficient and rounding) applies unchanged to a series on the non-standard list is not established by the transcription.
fee_findings.decision: fee_schedules.schedule_for('kalshi', 'KXNFLGAME') stays UnsupportedFeeSchedule. Changing it is a fee-policy change that needs the PDF's non-standard table semantics verified (and review), not an agent's inference.
fee_findings.next_step: Verify from the PDF text (pages 6-11 header and notes) whether non-standard taker fees use the general coefficient; capture a dated series and fee_changes record for KXNFLGAME through an authorized read; then add a verification record.
